parrafo.es: Chef Elisa y su equipo preparan y sirven bodas, eventos corporativos y celebraciones privadas en todo el sur de la Florida, para grupos de 50 a 500 invitados. Menú, personal y barra, todo coordinado de principio a fin.
parrafo.en: Chef Elisa and her team cook and serve weddings, corporate events and private celebrations across South Florida, for groups of 50 to 500 guests. Menu, staffing and bar service, all coordinated start to finish.

parrafo_1.es: Chef Elisa's Catering es un negocio de catering integral en el sur de la Florida: menú, personal de servicio, mobiliario y barra para bodas, eventos corporativos y celebraciones privadas de 50 a 500 invitados.
parrafo_1.en: Chef Elisa's Catering is a full-service catering business in South Florida: menu, serving staff, rentals and bar service for weddings, corporate events and private celebrations of 50 to 500 guests.

parrafo_2.es: Chef Elisa ha cocinado para celebridades y atletas profesionales en el sur de la Florida, y sus clientes de eventos lo confirman: comida que se recuerda y un servicio que no falla, desde una boda bajo carpa hasta el almuerzo de una gran empresa.
parrafo_2.en: Chef Elisa has cooked for celebrities and professional athletes around South Florida, and her event clients say the same thing: food people remember and service that does not miss, from a tented wedding to a big company lunch.

titulo.en: You call and tell us about your event

texto.es: Fecha, número de invitados y el tipo de celebración: boda, evento corporativo o fiesta privada.
texto.en: Date, guest count and the kind of celebration: wedding, corporate event or private party.

texto.es: Chef Elisa arma la propuesta de entradas, plato fuerte y postres, con opciones sin gluten y vegetarianas.
texto.en: Chef Elisa puts together the appetizers, main course and dessert, with gluten-free and vegetarian options.

texto.es: Te damos un precio según invitados, menú y lo que necesites: personal, mobiliario o barra.
texto.en: We give you a price based on guests, menu and what you need: staff, rentals or bar service.

texto.es: El equipo llega, monta y sirve. Tú disfrutas tu evento, nosotros nos ocupamos de la cocina.
texto.en: The team arrives, sets up and serves. You enjoy your event, we handle the kitchen.

nota.es: Cada evento se cotiza según invitados y menú. Llama y te damos el precio sin compromiso.
nota.en: Every event is quoted based on guest count and menu. Call and we will give you a price, no obligation.

texto.es: Catering completo para bodas, eventos corporativos y celebraciones privadas de 50 a 500 invitados.
texto.en: Full catering for weddings, corporate events and private celebrations, from 50 to 500 guests.

texto.es: Hojaldres de espinaca, chicken pops, chicken & waffles, rollitos de vegetales y mini pitas con tzatziki, entre otros.
texto.en: Spinach turnovers, chicken pops, chicken & waffles, vegetable rolls and mini pitas with tzatziki, among others.

texto.es: Almuerzos y eventos de empresa, con el mismo cuidado que una boda: a sus clientes les sobró para elogiarlo.
texto.en: Company lunches and corporate events, with the same care as a wedding: clients keep praising it.

texto.es: Personal de servicio, mobiliario y barra de bebidas para completar tu evento de principio a fin.
texto.en: Serving staff, rentals and a drink bar to round out your event from start to finish.

pie.es: ¿No ves tu tipo de evento? Llama igual, seguro lo cubrimos.
pie.en: Do not see your type of event listed? Call anyway, we likely cover it.

subtitulo.en: 12 reviews on Google, rated 4.7 out of 5.

items.quote: Chef Elisa and her team catered a party I attended last night providing unique and delicious bites including flaky spinach turnovers, chicken pops, chicken & waffles, fresh vegetable rolls, meatballs on pita with tzatziki sauce, desserts, ...

Excellent food, great service, very friendly staff, the mojitos, churrasco, the chicken with the hollandaise sauce the veggies, appetizers you name it!! The best catering experience with a catering service! I highly recommend them for your next event!

We had a very big company event last week and our lunch was the most delicious lunch I ever had in many years done by a catering company, the service was amazing, but the food was delicious!!! They are the best!
